text_block_list.text:
After her win, Эйсин Флэш can barely
contain her
joy. Meanwhile, her parents
are over the moon
with her outstanding
accomplishment.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Once again, lofty ambitions for victory
stir within
her. We agree to continue
with her plan to
complete all her
scheduled races.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
However, due to a health concern, I
decide to
remove the Classic Triple
Crown's final race, the
Kikuka Sho, from
her schedule.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Her perfectly constructed plan is now in
ruins.
This new reality throws Eishin
Flash's spirit into
chaos.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
